notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness. You control a permanent of each color.
description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
